dedupe_keys.name: coudlabs wp8 t811 udc 002 application of imaging velocimetry techniques for urban drainage applications

description: Naves, Juan at Universidade da Coruña publishes raw and processed imagery for runoff particle-image velocimetry through Co-UDlabs. A camera system and LSPIV method measure surface flow in the UDC BLOCK rainfall simulator. The collection includes velocity maps and tests of preprocessing/postprocessing under realistic rainfall, with archives for test groups and time series. Coverage is the Universidade da Coruña BLOCK laboratory facility in Spain; acquisition dates and image resolution are not stated. Zenodo provides test and time-series ZIP archives with a PDF report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the experiment evaluates a particular camera/processing setup, and output velocity accuracy cannot be checked without the unread calibration and numerical files. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
